channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Dólar abre em alta com empate entre Flávio e Lula e aprovação da escala 6x1 no radar
item.description: The dollar opened higher at R$5.053, reflecting a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the latest Quaest poll, with 46% and 44% vote intentions, respectively. The 6x1 scale was also approved on the radar, impacting the economy.

item.title: Na pesquisa Indexa/Broadcast, 50% desaprovam forma de administrar de Lula; 45% a aprovam
item.description: Indexa/Broadcast poll shows 50% of voters disapprove of Lula's administration, while 45% approve and 5% do not express an opinion. The survey, released on Thursday (15), reflects significant division in public opinion regarding the incumbent president running for re-election.

item.title: Campanha de desinformação bolsonarista culpa Lula por fogo na Amazônia
item.description: A disinformation campaign by Bolsonarista supporters uses misleading data to blame Lula for Amazon fires, ignoring that deforestation reached a decade-low under his administration.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: aprovação é trunfo de Lula, mas terá efeito forte apenas se mobilização nas ruas for mantida
item.description: The Senate approved the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, reducing the workweek from 44 to 40 hours, seen as an electoral advantage for Lula. Allies, however, stress that its impact depends on street mobilizations. Flávio Bolsonaro, from PL, voted in favor of the measure, but his supporters claim that if elected, he will compensate businesses for increased costs.

item.title: Defensor do fim da 6x1, Cleitinho cobra contrapartida a empresas
item.description: Senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos-MG) advocated for compensation measures for businesses following the end of the 6×1 work schedule, demanding payroll tax breaks and reduced impostos. He also criticized parliamentary privileges and called for cuts within Congress itself.

item.title: Usado como exemplo pela direita, El Salvador deve soltar 46.000 presos
item.description: The President of El Salvador, Nayib Bukele, announced a conditional early release of 46,000 prisoners, half of those detained during the war on gangs, at an energy investment event. The Bukele model, cited as an example by the Brazilian right, includes mass incarceration and exceptional measures, being praised by Flávio Bolsonaro, who also promised harsher measures against criminals in Brazil.

item.title: Presidente do TSE se reúne com Meta para tratar de IA que cria imagem 'Flávio 22', mas se recusa a fazer o mesmo com 'Lula 13'
item.description: The president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, met with Meta to discuss the AI's refusal to generate campaign images of Lula, while accepting similar requests for Flávio Bolsonaro. Lula's campaign filed a lawsuit with the TSE accusing Meta of favoring the PL candidate. Following the controversy, Meta temporarily banned the creation of candidate images to comply with electoral rules.

item.title: PEC da Segurança: oposição tenta incluir redução da maioridade penal na votação desta quinta no Senado
item.description: The opposition in the Senate seeks to add the reduction of the criminal majority to the Security PEC, setting it at 16 years or 14 for serious crimes. The amendment, led by Rogério Marinho and backed by Flávio Bolsonaro, faces strong resistance from the government. The vote takes place in a politically polarized election context.

item.title: Campanha de Ciro Gomes pede cassação da chapa de Elmano no Ceará
item.description: Ciro Gomes' campaign filed a lawsuit with the Electoral Court requesting the annulment of Elmano de Freitas' ticket, alleging undue media advantages from STF and TSE decisions that granted extra advertising time, citing abuse of power.

item.title: 'As gangues, as armas e a batalha pelo Brasil': jornal britânico destaca protagonismo da violência de facções criminosas na eleição
item.description: The British newspaper Financial Times highlighted the role of criminal factions in the Brazilian electoral dispute, claiming that fear and anger towards organized crime have influenced recent elections in Latin America. Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is cited as a candidate who may benefit from this context of insecurity.

item.title: Decenas de millones de trabajadores logran un segundo día libre en Brasil, una victoria política para Lula
item.description: The Senate approved reducing the workweek from 44 to 40 hours without wage loss, benefiting 37 million workers. The move is a political victory for Lula, with Flávio Bolsonaro switching his vote. Elections take place in 10 days with a technical tie between candidates.

item.title: Crusoé: Aliados de Flávio convocam pastores para “clamor pelo Brasil”
item.description: Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro are calling evangelical pastors to participate in a 'clamor for Brazil' on Sunday, the 18th. The initiative, shared on social media by figures such as Silas Malafaia, gathers pentecostal leaders aligned with former President Jair Bolsonaro.

item.title: Canella, preso hoje, foi o responsável pela eleição de Rueda a deputado federal
item.description: Márcio Canella, arrested by the PF accused of leading a gang that laundered R$7.6 billion, was responsible for the election of Antonio Rueda, president of União Brasil, as federal deputy.

item.title: Flávio revoga tudo o que disse e pretendia enquanto Lula amplia uso da máquina em eleição aberta
item.description: As the runoff election remains tied, Lula expands the use of public machinery and announces popular measures to attract voters, while Flávio Bolsonaro reverses previous positions to appeal to the electorate. Polls show a technical tie between the two candidates, but with higher rejection rates for Flávio. Both campaigns are adjusting strategies to consolidate support in the final days before the vote.

item.title: Mendonça interrompe julgamento que tem maioria para derrubar sua decisão
item.description: TSE minister André Mendonça halted a virtual hearing on a Lula campaign video criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro's economic proposals, referring the case to the full court. A majority of ministers (4 to 3) supported overturning Mendonça's decision, keeping the video suspended pending a new ruling.

item.title: Lula diz que não tem dinheiro para comprar celular e usará o de Janja
item.description: President Lula joked that he has no money to buy a phone and will borrow First Lady Janja's to join the 'Lula Army' WhatsApp channel. The channel, with 4.4 million followers, was suspended and later reinstated after a TSE decision, pending the 5 million goal for direct presidential interaction.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 44% e Lula 42% no 2º turno, em empate técnico, aponta Indexa/Broadcast
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leads with 44% and Lula (PT) with 42% in a technical tie for the second round, according to the Indexa/Broadcast poll. The simulation surveyed voters aged 16 and over between October 13 and 14, 2026, with a margin of error of ±2.2 percentage points.

item.title: Em evento com Milei, Eduardo Bolsonaro rechaça retorno ao Brasil para 'puxar cadeia sendo inocente' e defende 'fora' Moraes
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro refused to serve a prison sentence in Brazil, declaring his innocence and criticizing Minister Moraes. At an event with Argentine President Milei, he called for Moraes' removal from the Supreme Court and supported his brother Flávio Bolsonaro's presidential bid.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Datafolha testa disputa entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro: veja o horário
item.description: A new Datafolha poll, released Thursday (15) at 6:30 PM, will update voting intentions between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro for the 2026 second round, following a technical tie in the previous survey. The poll also measures Lula's government approval and the main electoral issue.

item.title: Combater o bolsonarismo com autoritarismo é confrontar-se com um espelho
item.description: The article argues that fighting bolsonarism with authoritarianism is facing a mirror, as both sides end up adopting intolerant and coercive methods. It criticizes the tendency of political groups, especially part of the left, to try to control behaviors and discourses under the pretext of fighting fascism.

item.title: Flávio pede que TSE investigue sindicatos e casse chapa de Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro filed a request with the TSE asking for investigations into unions and social organizations, accusing them of indirectly funding Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's campaign and requesting the annulment of the PT ticket for abuse of economic power. The document submitted by Flávio's campaign calls for probes into eight organizations, including MST and UNE, and demands the suspension of any use of these entities' infrastructure for pro-Lula electoral advertising. The accusation relies on statements by union leaders, such as Luiz Allan Kunzle, regarding resource allocation to local electoral committees.

item.title: PF prende Márcio Canella, ex-prefeito de Belford Roxo
item.description: The Federal Police arrested Márcio Canella, a former mayor and elected state representative from União Brasil-RJ, during the 8th phase of the 'Unha e Carne' operation targeting a money laundering scheme using gas stations in Rio de Janeiro. Authorized by Minister Alexandre de Moraes, the operation led to additional arrests and seizures, with suspected police involvement. The scheme is estimated to have moved over R$7.6 billion in the past six years.

item.title: PF prende Márcio Canella em operação contra lavagem de dinheiro em postos de combustíveis
item.description: The Federal Police arrested former mayor and elected state representative Márcio Canella (União Brasil) in the eighth phase of Operation Unha e Carne, accused of money laundering through a network of gas stations in Rio de Janeiro. The operation investigates an armed criminal organization that moved over R$ 7.6 billion in the last six years.

item.title: Ferramenta digital passa a permitir buscar imóveis por CPF ou CNPJ em todo o Brasil
item.description: The National Property Search (PNB) now allows property searches by CPF or CNPJ across Brazil, reaching over 3,600 notary offices quickly. The platform, integrated with AI-driven databases from ONR, accesses 90 million property records and is primarily used by public agencies to track irregular assets and combat crimes such as money laundering.

item.title: Na votação pelo fim da jornada 6x1, o oportunismo eleitoral é de quem votou a favor sendo contra
item.description: The vote to end the 6x1 work schedule, 11 days before the runoff, sparked debates over electoral opportunism. Opposition to the PEC from figures like Flávio Bolsonaro, who shifted stance before the election, was criticized. The hourly wage project, supported by the PL candidate, was deemed poorly explained and harmful.

item.title: Em campanha no RS, Flávio vota à distância a favor do fim da 6x1
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), presidential candidate, voted virtually in favor of the constitutional amendment ending the 6x1 work schedule during a campaign event in Rio Grande do Sul. His virtual participation underscores campaign scheduling and prioritization of electoral activities.

item.title: PEC da Segurança Pública será votada no Senado nesta quinta-feira
item.description: The Public Security PEC will be voted on in the Senate in two rounds on the same night on Thursday, after approval at the CCJ. The proposal is a priority of the federal government and provides for the creation of the Ministry of Public Security, more resources for security, integration between forces and harsher sentences for criminal factions. Allies of Flávio Bolsonaro included an amendment to reduce the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16 years.

item.title: Fim da 6x1: trabalhador poderá ter direito a duas folgas já em dezembro
item.description: A PEC approved by the Senate allows 6×1 shift workers to have two weekly rest days starting in December 2026, with a gradual reduction of the workweek from 44 to 40 hours. The measure, which does not require presidential approval, is a key campaign pledge of Lula against Flávio Bolsonaro and was approved with majority support, opposed only by Mourão.

item.title: Erika Hilton celebra fim da escala 6x1: "Voz do povo venceu"
item.description: The Senate approved the constitutional amendment ending the 6×1 work schedule, ensuring two weekly rest days, 40 working hours, and wage protection. Federal lawmaker Erika Hilton celebrated the victory for workers and criticized opposition from the far right and allies of Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Fiesp critica fim da escala 6x1: "Decisões açodadas têm um preço alto"
item.description: Fiesp criticized the approval of the end of the 6×1 work schedule, warning of increased informality and impacts on sectors such as health and education. Paulo Skaf called the decision reckless and highlighted the high cost for society.

item.title: O fim da escala 6x1 aprovado no Congresso - O Assunto #1825
item.description: The Brazilian Senate plenary approved the PEC limiting the workweek to 40 hours and establishing a two-day paid rest period for every five working days, effectively ending the 6x1 shift system nationwide. The agenda, supported by President Lula's government and one of his campaign pillars, gained momentum after Flávio Bolsonaro reversed his position and declared support for the measure.

item.title: Ao lado de Eduardo, Milei chama Lula de ditador: "Vamos expulsar a chutes"
item.description: At the Hispanic Heritage Gala in Washington, Argentine President Javier Milei labeled Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva a 'communist dictator' and stated he would be removed from power 'by force'. Milei expressed support for Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy, whose brother Eduardo Bolsonaro attended the event and joined the Argentine president on stage.

item.title: Surto eleitoreiro de Lula não parece ter fim
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has rolled out a wave of populist measures that challenge electoral law by promising free distribution of goods and benefits during the election year. Beyond their legal ambiguity, these pledges risk harming the economy through spending and borrowing with uncertain returns, leaving a mounting debt for the next administration. The article underscores the unchecked growth of public spending on electoral benefits and its adverse impact on publicaccounts.

item.title: Queda na renovação da Câmara está associada a emendas parlamentares
item.description: The renewal of the Chamber of Deputies has declined in recent elections, dropping from 47.4% in 2018 to 35.7% in 2026, largely due to the strategic use of parliamentary amendments that favor reelection. Sitting deputies allocate funds to municipalities to consolidate electoral support, making it harder for new faces to enter the legislature. This mechanism has been identified as one of the main barriers to political renewal in Brazil.

item.title: Governistas festejam 6 X 1 e chamam proposta de Flávio de escravidão
item.description: The Senate approved a constitutional amendment reducing the workweek from 44 to 40 hours, celebrated by Lula's allies and criticized by Flávio Bolsonaro. Reginaldo Lopes labeled Flávio's hourly wage proposal as modern slavery. The vote boosts Lula ahead of the presidential runoff.

item.title: Discurso de Flávio não cabe na Faria Lima
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro struggles to build a moderate image in the 2026 campaign, backtracking from radical stances like the 6x1 scale. Criticisms question his true economic commitment and suggest electoral opportunism.

item.title: “Flávio usa trabalhadores para se eleger”, diz Erika Hilton
item.description: Erika Hilton (Psol-SP) accused Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) of using the approval of the PEC ending the 6 X 1 work schedule solely for electoral purposes, criticizing his absence from the Senate during the vote. The lawmaker labeled the change an electoral maneuver to attract votes in the presidential race and warned that if elected, Flávio could reverse the measure. Hilton also demanded transparency and a clear stance from the senator on the impact of the schedule on female workers, especially atypical mothers.

item.title: Lula x Flávio: Datafolha divulga nova pesquisa de 2º turno hoje (15/10)
item.description: Datafolha will release a new 2nd-round poll on Thursday (10/15) between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), surveying 2,520 respondents with a 2-point margin of error. The poll, commissioned by Globo and Folha, will be published starting at 6 PM and is registered under number BR-00466/2026.

item.title: Quaest, 2º turno: veja intenção de voto por região, gênero, idade, identificação política, cor e religião
item.description: Quaest poll released on October 14, 2026 shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at 46% and Lula (PT) at 44% in the second-round presidential vote intention. The survey, registered with the Electoral Court under BR-08729, interviewed 2,154 people between October 10-13 with a ±2 percentage point margin of error.

item.title: Fim da escala 6x1: relembre outros marcos da legislação trabalhista brasileira
item.description: The Brazilian Senate approved the end of the 6x1 work scale, a measure that reduces the workweek from 6 days to 5, affecting workers and companies. The approval occurs in a politically charged context, with differing positions between Lula, who supports the measure, and Flavio Bolsonaro, who changed his stance during the campaign. The amendment now moves to promulgation and represents a milestone in Brazilian labor legislation, which includes historic advances such as the CLT and the right to strike.

item.title: Debate presidencial da Globo: quando será e onde assistir
item.description: The TV Globo presidential debate between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) will take place on Friday, October 23, at 9:20 PM BRT, after the Jornal Nacional, at the Estúdios Globo in Rio de Janeiro, moderated by César Tralli. The broadcast will be available on TV Globo, GloboNews, g1 and Globoplay. Prior to the debate, the network will also conduct individual interviews with the candidates.

item.title: Famílias na política: veja quem venceu e quem perdeu nas eleições de 2026
item.description: In the 2026 elections, both traditional and rising political families saw mixed results. The Bolsonaro family led the ascent, with Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) advancing to the presidential runoff and four family members elected to legislative offices. However, families like the Calheiros and Sarney suffered major defeats, while others such as the Barbalho and Arraes maintained strong electoral performance.

item.title: Datafolha divulga nova pesquisa presidencial nesta quinta-feira (15)
item.description: Datafolha will release a new 2026 presidential runoff poll on Thursday (15), with a two-point margin of error and 95% confidence level. The survey, commissioned by Folha de S.Paulo, interviews 2,520 people between October 13 and 15. In the previous poll, Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) led with 49% against Lula (PT)'s 45%.

item.title: Quaest: 10% dos eleitores de Flávio Bolsonaro no 1º turno decidiram voto no dia da eleição; de Lula, 5%
item.description: Quaest poll shows 10% of Flávio Bolsonaro's voters and 5% of Lula's decided on election day in the first round, while 84% of Lula's supporters had already chosen before the campaign started. In the second round, both candidates are tied technically with 46% and 44% of voting intentions, within the two-point margin of error.

item.title: Entrevista de Lula na Globo: veja quando e onde assistir
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) will be interviewed by TV Globo on Thursday (15) after the Jornal Nacional, with live coverage also on GloboNews and g1. Conducted by Renata Lo Prete, the interview will air after the live broadcast and later be available on Globoplay. The presidential debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) is scheduled for October 23.

item.title: Mendonça paralisa julgamento no TSE após formação de maioria para derrubar sua decisão sobre vídeo de Lula
item.description: Minister André Mendonça interrupted the hearing at TSE after a majority was formed to overturn his decision ordering the removal of a video by Lula about Flávio Bolsonaro's 'budget slash'. Most ministers had voted to allow the video's reinstatement, but the rapporteur's request to highlight the case delayed the proceedings, temporarily maintaining the content's suspension.

item.title: "Voltamos", celebra Janones após volta do canal "Exército do Lula"
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) resumed posting on the 'Exército do Lula' WhatsApp channel after TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques authorized its full restart. The channel, which has over 4.3 million members, was temporarily suspended following a judicial decision, but its operation was reactivated after a meeting between Janones and the minister. The group is used to mobilize supporters of Lula in the re-election campaign.

item.title: Plenário grita "Lula"; Flávio vota sim, mas apoia PEC da hora trabalhada
item.description: The Senate approved PEC 221/2019, which reduces the workweek from 44 to 40 hours and ends the 6x1 schedule, with a vote of 75 to 1. The approval happens amid convergence between government and opposition, benefiting Lula's campaign. Flávio Bolsonaro voted in favor but maintained a critical stance, while supporting the labor time law.

item.title: Canal Exército do Lula volta ao ar após registro no TSE
item.description: The Exército do Lula WhatsApp channel, with 4.3 million subscribers, resumed operations after being formally registered with the Electoral Court, as ordered by TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques. The reactivation follows a temporary suspension and partial restoration, with the channel administered by federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG).

item.title: Lula comemora fim da escala 6 X 1: “Sorte do povo brasileiro”
item.description: President Lula celebrated the approval of the PEC ending the 6x1 work schedule, a historic achievement for workers, ensuring two paid rest days without salary reduction. The vote took place 11 days before the runoff, with 75 favorable votes and one opposing, highlighting the unexpected support from Flávio Bolsonaro.
